Q. How can I find business case studies?

How do I find business case studies at NYIT Library?

Answered By: Sebastien Marion
Last Updated: Jan 31, 2024     Views: 158

Here are 2 options for finding business case studies using NYIT Library's online databases. 
 

1. Search NYIT Library database Business Source Complete (http://www.nyit.edu/library > articles & databases > business).

Tip 1: Enter keywords + scroll down the page to Document Type, and select Case Study from the menu.

 

Tip 2: In addition, try limiting to Harvard Business Review who publishes 1 case study per issue (don’t forget to select case study under document type).

 

2. Search NYIT Library database ProQuest Central (http://www.nyit.edu/library > articles & databases > business).

Tip: Click Advanced Search + enter keywords + scroll down the page to Document Type, and select Case Study from the menu.
